lyrics.ja: あの日見た空は 遠くに見えたよ
lyrics.romaji: Ano Hi Mita Sora ha Tooku ni Mieta yo
lyrics.en: The sky I saw that day looked so far away
lyrics.zh: 那一天看見的天空，看起來好遙遠

lyrics.ja: 果てしないほどに遠く
lyrics.romaji: Hateshinai Hodo ni Tooku
lyrics.en: So far it seemed endless
lyrics.zh: 遙遠得彷彿無邊無際

lyrics.ja: 無理だと思った だけど違ってたよ
lyrics.romaji: Muri Da to Omotta Dakedo Chigatteta yo
lyrics.en: I thought it was impossible—but I was wrong
lyrics.zh: 曾以為不可能，但我錯了

lyrics.ja: いつの間にか 変わってた
lyrics.romaji: Itsu no Ma ni ka Kawatteta
lyrics.en: Before I knew it, things had changed
lyrics.zh: 不知不覺間，一切已經改變

lyrics.ja: 背中に 気がついたら 羽が生えていたんだ
lyrics.romaji: Senaka ni Ki ga Tsuitara Hane ga Haete Ita n Da
lyrics.en: Before I noticed, wings had grown on my back
lyrics.zh: 回過神來，背上已經長出了翅膀

lyrics.ja: 勇気を 出して足を 地面から離してみたよ
lyrics.romaji: Yuuki wo Dashite Ashi wo Jimen kara Hanashite Mita yo
lyrics.en: I gathered my courage and tried lifting my feet off the ground
lyrics.zh: 鼓起勇氣，試著讓雙腳離開地面

lyrics.ja: ふわり この翼 はためかせて
lyrics.romaji: Fuwari Kono Tsubasa Hatamekasete
lyrics.en: Softly fluttering these wings
lyrics.zh: 輕盈地拍動這雙翅膀

lyrics.ja: 私 これからは 飛んで行けるよ
lyrics.romaji: Watashi Kore kara ha Tonde Ikeru yo
lyrics.en: From now on, I can fly
lyrics.zh: 從今以後，我就能飛翔了

lyrics.ja: 思い 絵描いていた あの空へ
lyrics.romaji: Omoi Egaite Ita Ano Sora e
lyrics.en: Toward that sky I had pictured in my heart
lyrics.zh: 飛向心中描繪的那片天空

lyrics.ja: お願い このまま 私を 飛ばさせて
lyrics.romaji: Onegai Kono Mama Watashi wo Tobasasete
lyrics.en: Please, just like this, let me fly
lyrics.zh: 拜託了，就讓我這樣飛翔

lyrics.ja: 変わり始めてる 私の世界に
lyrics.romaji: Kawari Hajimeteru Watashi no Sekai ni
lyrics.en: In my world that has begun to change
lyrics.zh: 在開始改變的我的世界裡

lyrics.ja: まだ戸惑いもあるけど
lyrics.romaji: Mada Tomadoi mo Aru kedo
lyrics.en: There's still some confusion
lyrics.zh: 雖然還有些迷惘

lyrics.ja: いつかは必ず たどり着くはずだと
lyrics.romaji: Itsuka ha Kanarazu Tadoritsuku Hazu Da to
lyrics.en: But I can believe now
lyrics.zh: 但如今我能夠相信

lyrics.ja: 今は信じられるんだ
lyrics.romaji: Ima ha Shinjirareru n Da
lyrics.en: That someday I'll surely arrive
lyrics.zh: 總有一天必定能抵達

lyrics.ja: 羽ばたき 続けないと 落ちてしまいそうだよ
lyrics.romaji: Habataki Tsuzukenai to Ochite Shimaisou Da yo
lyrics.en: If I don't keep flapping, I feel like I'll fall
lyrics.zh: 若不持續振翅，似乎就會墜落

lyrics.ja: 私は 止まらないよ 羽が消えてなくなるまで
lyrics.romaji: Watashi ha Tomaranai yo Hane ga Kietenaku Naru made
lyrics.en: I won't stop—until my wings vanish away
lyrics.zh: 我不會停下，直到翅膀消失為止

lyrics.ja: ふわり みんなから もらった気持ち
lyrics.romaji: Fuwari Minna kara Moratta Kimochi
lyrics.en: Softly, the feelings I received from everyone
lyrics.zh: 輕盈地，從大家那裡收到的情感

lyrics.ja: 翼に変わって 飛んでいるんだ
lyrics.romaji: Tsubasa ni Kawatte Tonde Iru n Da
lyrics.en: Have turned into wings, and I'm flying
lyrics.zh: 化作了翅膀，讓我飛翔

lyrics.ja: いつか 絵描いていた あの空へ
lyrics.romaji: Itsuka Egaite Ita Ano Sora e
lyrics.en: Toward that sky I once pictured
lyrics.zh: 飛向曾經描繪的那片天空

lyrics.ja: 翼を 羽ばたき 続けて 行くからね
lyrics.romaji: Tsubasa wo Habataki Tsuzukete Iku kara ne
lyrics.en: I'll keep flapping my wings and go on
lyrics.zh: 我會持續振翅前行

lyrics.ja: まだ私は あまりうまく 飛ぶことができない けれど
lyrics.romaji: Mada Watashi ha Amari Umaku Tobu Koto ga Dekinai Keredo
lyrics.en: I still can't fly very well
lyrics.zh: 雖然我還不太會飛

lyrics.ja: 約束だよ その時まで 見守ってね
lyrics.romaji: Yakusoku Da yo Sono Toki made Mimamotte ne
lyrics.en: But it's a promise—watch over me until then, okay?
lyrics.zh: 這是約定喔，在那之前請守護著我

lyrics.ja: 私の姿が 見えてますか
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Sugata ga Miete Masu ka
lyrics.en: Can you see my figure?
lyrics.zh: 你看得見我的身影嗎

lyrics.ja: 私の歌声 聞こえてますか
lyrics.romaji: Watashi no Utagoe Kikoete Masu ka
lyrics.en: Can you hear my singing voice?
lyrics.zh: 你聽得見我的歌聲嗎

lyrics.ja: 今日も みんなの 気持ち集めて
lyrics.romaji: Kyou mo Minna no Kimochi Atsumete
lyrics.en: Today too, gathering everyone's feelings
lyrics.zh: 今天也收集著大家的心意

lyrics.ja: 私は あの時の空へ 飛び立つよ
lyrics.romaji: Watashi ha Ano Toki no Sora e Tobitatsu yo
lyrics.en: I'll take off toward the sky of that time
lyrics.zh: 我將飛向那時的天空
